intent: Vanilla-style granular dye heaps. Each pigment is authored separately, then composited above the unchanged creator wooden_base.png. Amber is creator-owned and excluded.

styleReference.purpose: Creator-selected vanilla-style granular pigment reference; keep original unchanged.

correction.rationale: The inspected heap had near-black contour seams and separated highlights that read as cracked stone. Repaint only the pigment with connected lit grains, a colored contour and a short shaded underside, following the inspected vanilla dye references. Keep the creator plate as the exact lower layer.
correction.expected_effect: A loose vanilla-style powder heap with connected light/mid clusters and readable color at 16x16; creator Amber and wooden_base remain unchanged.

correction.rationale: After the first palette pass, the dark pigment still read as a smooth solid clump. Repaint the named pigment clusters into connected two-pixel lit grains interrupted by midtone paths; protect the lower wooden layer and all other colors.
